---
name: Feature request
about: Propose a feature or improvement for V
title: "[feature] "
labels: enhancement
---

## Problem or need

Issues are public. Do not include credentials, private
recordings or transcripts. Report suspected vulnerabilities through
[SECURITY.md](../../SECURITY.md).

Describe the problem you want to solve or the need behind this request. Avoid
jumping straight to the solution.

## Proposal

Describe the feature or change you propose.

## Alternatives considered

Did you consider another way to solve the same problem? Why do you prefer this
proposal?

## Relation to existing work

Is there an open issue, a pull request or an item in the
[roadmap](../../ROADMAP.md) that already covers this? Link it.

## Architecture and privacy impact

- Does this change need a new dependency? If so, explain why the standard
  library and the existing dependencies are not enough (see
  [CONTRIBUTING.md](../../CONTRIBUTING.md)).
- Does it affect the Clean/Hexagonal boundaries, offline mode, or the default
  binding to `127.0.0.1`?
- Does it need a new or updated ADR in `docs/adr/`?

## Additional context

Any other detail, screenshot or reference that helps evaluate the proposal.
